# Test files the Windows CI job does NOT run, and why.
#
# Every name here is skipped because the TEST is POSIX-only, never because the
# code it covers is. The suite's fake CLIs are `#!/bin/sh` scripts made
# executable with `chmod`, and `chmod` plus a shebang mean nothing on Windows;
# a few others create POSIX symlinks or assert POSIX file modes. Rewriting them
# as portable shims is a separate piece of work: it would touch 33 files and
# change what they prove on the platform the plugin is actually developed on.
#
# Everything not listed here runs on windows-latest. `npm test` on macOS and
# Linux still runs the whole glob, unchanged.
#
# The workflow reads this file; a blank line or a `#` comment is ignored.

# --- Fake-CLI harness: writes a `#!/bin/sh` script and chmods it 0755 ---
account-failover.test.ts
btw-command.test.ts
cli-events-stream.test.ts
cli-probe-cache.test.ts
context-usage.test.ts
deferred-cli-tool-result.test.ts
do-generate.test.ts
effort-sessions.test.ts
mcp-late-connect.test.ts
mcp-tool-result-name.test.ts
model-fallback.test.ts
process-lifecycle.test.ts
prologue-abort.test.ts
proxy-mcp.test.ts
proxy-task.test.ts
respawn.test.ts
result-fallback.test.ts
session-fork.test.ts
session-model-switch.test.ts
session-resume.test.ts
side-question.test.ts
silent-turn.test.ts
skill-bridge.test.ts
stale-build.test.ts
startup-diagnostics.test.ts
tool-block-index.test.ts
unattended-replay.test.ts

# --- Asserts the generated per-account wrapper, which is a bash script ---
# The wrapper itself is POSIX-only on every platform today; see AGENTS.md.
account-wrapper.test.ts

# --- POSIX file modes and symlinks ---
# 0700 / 0600 scratch-dir modes and symlinked shared capabilities.
cleanup-stale.test.ts
tmp-dir.test.ts

# --- Interactive transport: a Bun PTY plus `#!/bin/sh` shims ---
interactive-pty.test.ts
interactive-result.test.ts
transport.test.ts
